The '''Eastern Enrichment Zone''' was one of several [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]] [[Agri-Corps Enrichment Zone|Enrichment Zones]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]]. The Eastern Enrichment Zone contained the [[Enrichment Dome]] and an [[Main administration building|administration building]], where the [[Meerian/Legends|Meerian]] [[RonTha]] was employed. The AgriCorps workers stationed here were researching [[Dactyl]], a [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] that [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] needed to consume if they were to survive on a planet other than their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. The [[Scientist/Legends|researchers]] hoped to incorporate the crystal into the food supply.<ref name="TDR" />

In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] sent his aspiring [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to the Eastern Enrichment Zone to learn about the AgriCorps' work at the [[Enrichment Dome|facility]] and to report back to him on their progress.<ref name="TDR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Eastern Enrichment Zone featured in the young adult novel [[Jedi Apprentice: The Dark Rival]], the second book in the [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|Jedi Apprentice]] series written by [[Jude Watson]].
